description: Defines the inter_slice_scheduler class responsible for inter-slice scheduling in a radio network, including slice management, candidate selection, and resource allocation.

classes.name: inter_slice_scheduler
classes.description: Main class managing inter-slice scheduling, including slice state updates, candidate retrieval, and resource management.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Resets the state of slices based on the current slot and resource grid.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a user equipment (UE) to the scheduler.

methods.name: reconf_ue
methods.description: Reconfigures a UE within the scheduler.

methods.name: rem_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from the scheduler.

methods.name: config_applied
methods.description: Applies configuration changes for a UE.

methods.name: get_next_dl_candidate
methods.description: Retrieves the next downlink RAN slice candidate for scheduling.

methods.name: get_next_ul_candidate
methods.description: Retrieves the next uplink RAN slice candidate for scheduling.
